primary_interest.quote: I'd love to understand what's got you looking at voice AI agents. What's the use case on your side?

use_case.quote: right now it's staff making calls to see if patients are, you know, a fit for certain programs. It's a lot of manual work. We want to automate some of that.

inference_framing.quote: With Telnyx Voice AI the inference is part of the agent, so you're not stitching together a model host, telephony, and speech separately.

inference_raised_by.quote: the agent needs an LLM behind it, obviously.

competitors_inference.quote: We've been looking at OpenAI direct and also Baseten for that part.

decision_criteria.quote: What I care about is that the bill is predictable.

stated_reason.quote: If there's a long pause, people hang up.
